personas.tagline: The strategist who plans every move

personas.name: Captain America
personas.tagline: Loyal to the plan, bid hits like clockwork

personas.name: Black Widow
personas.tagline: Reads the room, plays the long game

personas.name: Thor
personas.tagline: Hammers down trump cards, no subtlety

personas.name: The Wolf
personas.tagline: Loyal pack thinker, leads when it matters

personas.name: The Eagle
personas.tagline: Sees the whole table at once

personas.name: The Lion
personas.tagline: Brave, leads from the front, takes risks

personas.name: The Bee
personas.tagline: Organised, busy, every card has a job

personas.name: N
personas.tagline: Solves the game like a puzzle — one cold move at a time
personas.fact: Near fidgets with toys and finger puppets while thinking. He built a massive tower of dice during one of his most critical deductions in the Kira case.

personas.name: Ryuk
personas.tagline: Plays for chaos, not victory — bored gods make wild moves
personas.fact: Ryuk is hopelessly addicted to apples — he describes human-world apples as being like cigarettes and alcohol combined for shinigami, and goes through withdrawal contortions without them.

personas.name: Light Yagami
personas.tagline: The god complex — plans five moves ahead, bids like royalty
personas.fact: Light scored a perfect 100% on nationwide university entrance exams while simultaneously running a secret campaign as Kira — the only student in Japan to achieve a perfect score.

personas.name: Flintstones
personas.tagline: Yabba dabba doo — loud bids, big heart, lucky stumbles
personas.fact: Fred Flintstone was the first animated character shown in bed with his spouse on prime-time American TV. The show was originally aimed at adults, not children.

personas.name: Samurai Jack
personas.tagline: Reads opponents, strikes at the right moment

personas.name: Baloo
personas.tagline: Bare necessities — coasts easy, clutches hard
personas.fact: In TaleSpin, Baloo was reimagined as a cargo pilot running a failing air freight business — a surprisingly ambitious reinvention for a character whose philosophy is doing as little as possible.

personas.name: Uncle Scrooge
personas.tagline: Tougher than the toughies, smarter than the smarties
personas.fact: In Don Rosa's backstory, Scrooge earned his Number One Dime as a shoeshine boy in Glasgow — an American dime from a ditch-digger that taught him to always be smarter and tougher than everyone.

personas.name: Popeye
personas.tagline: Starts slow, eats spinach, finishes strong
personas.fact: Popeye was a minor one-off character in the comic strip Thimble Theatre in 1929, which had been running for 10 years before he appeared. He was so popular he took over the entire strip.

personas.name: Krrish
personas.fact: Krrish's mask was inspired by a Venetian carnival mask. Hrithik performed most stunts himself, including the iconic flying scene shot in Singapore.

personas.name: Shaktimaan
personas.fact: Shaktimaan ran for 400+ episodes on Doordarshan and was India's first live-action superhero. Mukesh Khanna trained in yoga for the role — the seven chakra powers were based on real Kundalini concepts.

personas.name: Bugs Bunny
personas.tagline: Calm trickster, "Eh, what's up doc" energy

personas.name: Johnny Bravo
personas.tagline: All flex, all bid, no plan

personas.name: Doraemon
personas.tagline: Has a gadget for every situation

personas.name: Charizard
personas.tagline: Fiery, proud, loves a new challenge

personas.name: Snorlax
personas.tagline: Unmovable, waits for the perfect bite

personas.name: Gengar
personas.tagline: Mischief in the shadows, springs the trap

personas.name: Eevee
personas.tagline: Adapts to whatever the table needs

personas.name: Psyduck
personas.tagline: Flails — then accidentally wins the trick

personas.name: Alakazam
personas.tagline: Reads the whole table at once

personas.name: Dragonite
personas.tagline: Scary on paper, gentle in execution

personas.name: Lucario
personas.tagline: Reads the aura of every trick

personas.name: Odysseus
personas.tagline: The cunning strategist who always finds a way

personas.name: Dhurandhar
personas.tagline: The scheming secretary — always three moves ahead
personas.fact: Dhurandhar Pradhan from Panchayat is the quintessential small-town bureaucrat who runs the village from behind a desk. Faisal Malik's portrayal became so iconic that fans started calling real-life gram sachivs 'Dhurandhar'.

personas.name: Jawaan
personas.tagline: Patient vigilante — explodes when the moment comes
personas.fact: Jawan became the highest-grossing Hindi film of 2023, crossing 1100 crore worldwide. SRK played a dual role — the father's patience and the son's rage — mirroring two completely different card-playing styles.

personas.name: Lughai
personas.tagline: The patient elder — seen it all, never flustered
personas.fact: Lughai from Panchayat is the village pradhaan's silent enforcer who speaks in riddles. Durgesh Kumar's deadpan delivery made him a meme legend — his one-liners get more replays than the plot twists.

personas.name: Supandi
personas.tagline: Clueless but somehow still at the table
personas.fact: Supandi is Tinkle Comics' most beloved character since 1983. He's been fired from every job imaginable — but his misunderstandings are so pure that readers root for him anyway. The original creator based him on a real house-help.

personas.name: Shershaah
personas.tagline: Yeh dil maange more — fearless and clutch
personas.fact: Based on Captain Vikram Batra who captured Point 4875 in the Kargil War. His call sign was 'Shershaah' (Lion King). He famously radioed 'Yeh dil maange more' after capturing a peak — a Pepsi slogan turned war cry.

personas.name: Rajnikant
personas.tagline: Style has no limit — bends the game to his will
personas.fact: Rajnikant was a bus conductor in Bangalore before acting. His signature coin-flip and cigarette-flick were improvised on set. In Japan, his films are so popular that 'Muthu' ran for over a year in Tokyo theatres.

personas.name: Baahubali
personas.tagline: The warrior king — plans the war, not just the battle
personas.fact: Baahubali was India's first film to cross 1000 crore. The waterfall climbing scene took 109 days to shoot. 'Katappa ne Baahubali ko kyun maara?' became the most-asked question in Indian cinema history.

personas.name: Gully Boy
personas.tagline: Apna time aayega — underdog with a steep rise
personas.fact: Gully Boy was inspired by real Mumbai rappers Naezy and Divine. 'Apna Time Aayega' became an anthem for anyone hustling from the bottom. The film was India's official entry to the 92nd Academy Awards.

personas.name: Ranvijay Singh
personas.tagline: The Roadies king — thrives under pressure
personas.fact: Ranvijay won the first season of MTV Roadies in 2003 by cycling 350km through Rajasthan. He went from contestant to host to the face of Indian adventure TV. His catchphrase 'game on' defined a generation of reality TV.

personas.name: Stree
personas.tagline: Silent for rounds, then devastatingly precise
personas.fact: Stree was inspired by the urban legend of Nale Ba from 1990s Bangalore, where people wrote 'come tomorrow' on doors to ward off a witch. The film turned a horror premise into a 300 crore comedy franchise.

personas.name: Don
personas.tagline: Don ko pakadna mushkil hi nahi, namumkin hai
personas.fact: The original Don (1978) was Amitabh's idea of a double-role thriller. SRK's 2006 remake flipped the twist — the real Don was alive all along. The dialogue 'Don ko pakadna mushkil hi nahi, namumkin hai' is quoted more than any villain line in Hindi cinema.

personas.name: Bhediya
personas.tagline: Calm until the wolf takes over
personas.fact: Bhediya is set in Arunachal Pradesh and was the first Bollywood film to use real tribal folklore about shapeshifters. The VFX transformation sequence took 6 months to render — and Varun actually howled at the moon on set to get into character.

personas.name: Devdas
personas.fact: Devdas has been adapted 16 times across languages — more than any other Indian novel. SRK's 2002 version cost 50 crore (a record then) and premiered at Cannes. The character's flaw isn't love — it's the inability to act when it matters.

personas.name: Chunnilal
personas.fact: Chunnilal is Devdas's mirror — both are doomed, but Chunni knows it and still keeps hustling. Jackie Shroff's portrayal made him the heart of the film. His kotha scenes with Chandramukhi are considered some of the finest acting in 2000s Bollywood.
